name: Emaar Urban Oasis
summary: The project, developer (Emaar India), Sector 62 Golf Course Extension Road location and HARERA number GGM/741/473/2023/85 (Phase 1 & 2) are confirmed. Our ₹3.10 Cr starting price, 5 towers and 424 units match one source. Sources disagree heavily with each other: Square Yards shows ₹4.24 Cr, 4 towers, 525 units and 9.53 acres, and NoBroker shows 4 towers, 540 units and 9.5 acres. The RERA completion date is reported as July 2027, and marketed possession is Sep/Oct 2028, versus our December 2028. A Phase 4 is registered separately (GGM/888/620/2024/115).

checks.note: Our raw developer label is the project name (cosmetic).

checks.ours: Golf Course Extension Road, Sector 62, Sector 62, Gurugram, Haryana
checks.web: Near Banjara Market, Golf Course Extension, Sector 62, Gurgaon, Haryana 122098
GGM/741/473/2023/85 (Urban Oasis Phase 1 & 2, dated 07.08.2023); GGM/888/620/2024/115 (Urban Oasis Phase 4)
checks.note: Our number is correct for the main phases, but the separately registered Phase 4 is not listed.

checks.web: RERA completion July 2027 (wealthyventuresestate, 'as per HRERA document'); Square Yards: September 2028; NoBroker: October 2028; other listings: Sep 2029
checks.note: Ours is 2–3 months after the portal dates. The reported RERA date (July 2027) is 17 months earlier than ours and may have been extended. Sources disagree.

checks.web: wealthyventuresestate: ₹3.10 Cr onwards; NoBroker: ₹3 Cr – ₹9.41 Cr; Square Yards: ₹4.24 Cr – ₹10.53 Cr
checks.note: Two sources agree with us. Square Yards' ₹4.24 Cr (about 37% higher) likely reflects current resale or remaining inventory.

checks.ours: 2 BHK — 1,500 sq ft — Price on Request | 3 BHK — 2,212 sq ft — Price on Request | 3 BHK — 2,262 sq ft — Price on Request | 4 BHK — 3,039 sq ft — Price on Request
checks.web: wealthyventuresestate: 2 BHK 1,525, 3 BHK 2,124–4,770, 4 BHK 3,589–5,224 sq ft; Square Yards: 3 BHK 2,122/2,410, 4 BHK 3,040/5,266 sq ft (no 2 BHK); NoBroker carpet: 2 BHK 900, 3 BHK 1,343, 4 BHK 1,804–2,783 sq ft
checks.note: Only 4 BHK 3,039 (vs 3,040) and 3 BHK 2,262 (cited as a range bound) are close. Our 2 BHK 1,500 and 3 BHK 2,212 were not found exactly. The larger duplex and penthouse sizes (up to 5,266 sq ft) are missing from our data.

checks.web: Square Yards: 9.53 acres; NoBroker: 9.5 acres; wealthyventuresestate: 6.64 acres
checks.note: No source states 9.25 acres exactly. The closest figure is 9.5 to 9.53 acres, and the 6.64 acres figure may refer to a single phase.

checks.web: wealthyventuresestate: 5 towers, 424 units; Square Yards: 4 towers (up to 26 floors), 525 units; NoBroker: 4 towers (G+30), 540 units
checks.note: One source matches us exactly, but the two major portals both say 4 towers with 525–540 units. The difference may reflect phase scope.
